narrative.text:
I’ll inspect the existing addressed-message path, add regression tests, and verify they fail on the base before implementing the fix. Then I’ll run the required gates, commit locally, and prepare a public-safe PR draft.The existing path uses `metadata.mentioned`, which produces `chat:mention` for streams and makes the router treat the message as addressed. The adapter already caches message authors, so I can use that cache before falling back to its bounded authenticated GET.

I also found that all DMs, including group DMs, are currently addressed via `metadata.isDM`. I’ll preserve that behavior and test that an own-message quote sets the mention verdict in group DMs too.The new quote tests pass, and the first regression run failed on the base as expected. One scope conflict needs clarification before I finalize: the brief requires non-addressed negative cases in group DMs, but the baseline addresses every group DM. I’ve asked whether to preserve that behavior or include a group-DM addressing change.Clarification received: group DMs must remain addressed as they are today, with no quote lookup. The fix now applies only to streams that are not already mentioned.

The final 17 regression tests produce 8 failures on the base. They cover sender verification, cache use, lookup failures, unrelated links, fenced examples, multiple quotes, and unchanged group-DM behavior.Committed locally as `c741dc9`; nothing was pushed. All required gates pass. The full suite increased from 275 to 292 passing tests, with the same one skip, and all 17 new regression tests pass. The report includes the addressed-path citations, red/green evidence, residual risks, and a public-safe PR draft.
